title: Promise: I'll send you the paper tonight
description: Two friends talk about sleep and memory. Grace mentions a study about sleep and learning and promises to send Omar the paper tonight. Expect exactly one commitment whose text mentions sending the paper, and no pending thread.

utterances.text: I've been sleeping like five hours a night during exams and honestly my memory is garbage.
That tracks. I read somewhere that sleep is when your brain actually saves stuff.
Yeah, there's this study I read for my psych class. People learned a list of words, and the ones who slept after remembered way more.
Even if they slept the same total amount overall?
That's the interesting part. It was the sleep right after learning that mattered most. Something about replaying the memories in deep sleep.
So all-nighters before an exam are basically pointless.
Worse than pointless. You learn it and then never consolidate it.
I really should read more of this stuff instead of just doom-scrolling.
I'll send you the paper tonight, it's actually pretty readable.
Thanks, that'd be great. Does it say anything about naps?
A little. A twenty-minute nap helped a bit, but a ninety-minute one with deep sleep helped a lot more.
Ninety minutes is not a nap, that's a lifestyle.
Ha, right. I'm trying to just get seven hours this week and see if it helps.
Let me know if it does. I could use an excuse to go to bed earlier.
